loading.notes: Get Started — Week 0: 1 starter dose of two 80 mg injections on the same day (160 mg total).

maintenance.notes: Keep Going — Weeks 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12: 1 injection of 80 mg every 2 weeks. Maintain — Week 16 and on: 1 injection of 80 mg every 4 weeks for the rest of treatment.

supply_notes: Source: Taltz Adults dosing schedule infographic (Taltz Adults.png).
